verdict.rationale: The homepage describes a guided path where you describe a training task in natural language, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model. That counts as natural-language operation of fine-tuning, but it is a single marketing line and covers only one workflow. Tool calling (docs-2, docs-42) lets users build their own agents on Fireworks models; it is not a way to operate the platform itself, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: natural-language control of deployments, inference, billing and other platform operations; in-depth docs for the guided training flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
